properties.comment: Lake Region Electric will have a planned power outage on Monday, October 26th, beginning at 9 am and will last until approximately 12 noon.  Members affected will be in an area along 137th Street, from 434th Avenue, East to 436th Avenue and including Breske Bay.  Crews will be adding infrastructure to the line at this time.   If you work from home or have a medical condition that requires electricity, we request that you relocate during the outage time or use backup generation.  Thank you for your patience.
